# SCI-POINT ODQ-006 Scientific-Owner Approval

Record identity: `SCI-POINT-ODQ-006-APPROVAL-2026-09-02`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-09-02`

Status: approved Stage A scientific direction

## Approved Decision

Each requested observation-array-parent-method fit is an independent atomic
SCI-POINT result. POINT shall report one of these honest scientific states for
every requested array:

- complete for the stated POINT use;
- diagnostic-only, with the excluded use or claim and reason identified; or
- unavailable, with the reason identified.

Failure or unavailability of one array does not erase complete or diagnostic
results from another array. POINT shall not synthesize, impute, silently
replace, or report numerical zero for a missing array result.

A numerically completed fit that is constraint-limited, support-limited, or
missing some uncertainty information need not be discarded automatically. It
may remain diagnostic-only when the later exact named-use policy permits that
state. Numerical completion alone does not establish scientific usability.

SCI-POINT v0.1 does not create a whole-observation success result or aggregate
from the per-array states. Any downstream pointing-support producer owns
whether a partial array set is acceptable for its use and must identify the
members admitted, excluded, diagnostic-only, or unavailable and the exact
policy applied.

Physical co-location of multiple array results in one file or table does not
merge their scientific atomicity.

## Non-Effects

This approval does not define the ODQ-007 covariance representation, ODQ-009
named-use profile mechanics, or a downstream partial-array aggregation policy.
It does not approve the complete Stage A packet, authorize Stage B, change an
algorithm, or establish implementation conformity, validation, achieved
performance, readiness, or production state.
